$comment: Read by every Claude Code session in this repository. Only the maintainer decides what goes into main, and the master session merges it on his go (CLAUDE.md section 0); these rules make a session refuse, or ask its human, before GitHub has to. gh pr merge is 'ask', not 'deny', because a deny cannot be lifted for the master; the maintainer's own machine denies it outside the master with a hook. A local settings.local.json can override them, so they are a belt, not the lock: the lock is the ruleset on main.
